title: Add rich error context for streaming chat disconnects
author: Elliot Price
description: When streaming connections drop (often due to intermediate proxies), the Python SDK raised a generic ConnectionError without request metadata. This PR introduces StreamingChatError with fields for request_id (if present), http_status (if known), last_event_id (if present), and last_chunk_index. Also returns partial transcript collected so far to help customers implement safe retries. Includes docs notes and examples.
commits: sdk/python: propagate request headers into stream context
docs: retry guidance for streaming disconnects
